div.head: Hn 77.1
div.ab: Si quis de seruo patre natus sit et matre libera, pro seruo reddatur occisus in ea parte, quia semper a patre, non a matre generacionis ordo texitur.
div.note: New row (October 2026): Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 594 (two independent readings of the page images, differences settled against the page)

note.seg: Vgl. Gl unfrei 4. a. 10. Die gegenteilige feudale Anschauung 77, 2a scheint dem Verfasser zuwider. Die Ehe des Freien mit der Sklavin erklärt die Kirche für gültig; Theodor II 13, 5 = Confess. Ps.-Egb. 25; Ps.-Theod. 16, 33. Letztere beiden lassen das Kind der Unfreien, wenn vor deren Freilassung empfangen, unfrei—77, 2 nec{16}

Cf. Gl unfrei 4. a. 10. The contrary feudal view of 77, 2a seems repugnant to the author. The Church declares the marriage of a free man with a slave woman valid; Theodor II 13, 5 = Confess. Ps.-Egb. 25; Ps.-Theod. 16, 33. The latter two leave the child of the unfree woman unfree if it was conceived before her manumission—77, 2 nec{16}
